note: City of Jonestown, Texas — Development Code (Unified Development Code), Chapter 3 of the Code of Ordinances, Article 3 Land Use, Division 3.1 Land Uses by Zoning District, Section 3.1.1 ("General parameters for determining permitted land uses"), which carries the district dimensional charts (CHART 3.1.1-1 through CHART 3.1.1-5). ROUTE (this citation is authoritative but NOT reproducible by a plain GET of the cited file): eCode360 serves the substantive article text only through its print endpoint; the ordinary article page https://ecode360.com/40446470 renders the Section outline with NO body text and NO tables, and a plain fetch of it returns no dimensional standard at all (verified 2026-09-16). The text quoted here was read from https://ecode360.com/print/JO6363?guid=40446470, which returns the whole Chapter 3 as flattened text (about 2.7 MB of HTML). The charts in that print view are FLATTENED TABLES — every cell is emitted as its own line, so a chart row is a label/value sequence with no sentence form. Every quote below is therefore the chart's column header plus the verbatim cell values for that row (no number is paraphrased or converted), which is the closest verbatim form the source offers. VINTAGE (checked at source before extracting, per the batch-2 method changes): every Section 3.1.x citation line in the text read carries "( Ordinance 2025-O-650 adopted 1/9/2025 )"; later section citations in the same article read "Ordinance 2025-O-653 adopted 4/10/2025; Ordinance 2026-O-661 adopted 1/8/2026". The code's own New Laws panel (read on the article page 2026-09-16) lists exactly one adopted-but-not-yet-incorporated law for this chapter: Ordinance 2026-O-667, adopted 2026-06-11, whose own title in the panel is "2026-O-667 amend Ch 8 of Noise reg & Ch. 3 of UDC amplified sound". It amends Chapter 3 only as to amplified sound, so it does not disturb the dimensional charts; the dimensional text read here is NOT a repealed or superseded scheme. SENTINEL CONVENTION: every not_specified field carries the numeric sentinel 999 (the convention already used by round-rock-tx.json) together with provenance.not_specified = true and a verbatim quote of the source language that caused the gap. 999 is outside every gate sanity band, so if a not_specified flag were ever dropped the value would FLAG rather than silently read as a real standard. BASE CASE: CHART 3.1.1-1 ("REQUIREMENTS FOR LOTS") is codified as the base for every district, because CHART 3.1.1-2 is expressly conditioned on the lot being served by public sewer and CHART 3.1.1-3 is expressly limited to "EXISTING SUBDIVIDED LOTS THAT ARE LESS THAN ONE ACRE". The Chart 3.1.1-2 alternate values (front 25 ft. and street-side 20 ft. for GUI, O, B-1, B-2, I-1; R-1 unchanged) are quoted verbatim in each affected field's provenance and are NOT codified, so a caller must not read these as the only applicable numbers where a lot is on public sewer. CONDITIONAL (NON-SCALAR) CELLS: in Chart 3.1.1-1 the side-yard and rear-yard cells for GUI, O, B-1, B-2 and I-1 state a dependent rule rather than a number ("Note 1" for the side, "Note 2"/"Note 3" for the rear), and Note 1 itself is a two-branch rule keyed to the district being abutted. Those cells are coded 999/not_specified with the full Note text quoted verbatim rather than resolved to one branch, because resolving them would fabricate a number the ordinance does not state. MAX LOT COVERAGE: 999/not_specified for every residential district and for GUI, because Chart 3.1.1-5 states "N/A" for those districts' "Maximum Building Footprint". For O, B-1, B-2 and I-1 Chart 3.1.1-5 states the conditional pair "45% traditional/65% LID" (footnote * explains the two branches); 45 (traditional) is codified as the base with the full pair quoted, at reduced confidence, because the choice between the branches is the applicant's water-quality-control approach, not a district attribute. MAX IMPERVIOUS COVER: Chart 3.1.1-5 states "40%" for R-R, M-1, M-2, R-1, R-2 and R-3 (codified), and "LCRA**" for GUI, O, B-1, B-2 and I-1, where footnote ** reads "LCRA - For maximum impervious cover standards refer to Lower Colorado River Authority Highland Lakes Watershed Ordinance Manual, as amended" — i.e. the code delegates the numeric to an external instrument, so it is coded 999/not_specified with that delegation quoted verbatim. Chart 3.1.1-5's own notes also limit the calculation to land above the 685 MSL contour. OMITTED DISTRICTS (deliberate, mirroring the cibolo-tx.json precedent of omitting live codes that have no dimensional row): RV (Section 3.1.9) and PUD (Section 3.1.14) appear in the ordinance's 16-district list (Section 3.1.1.C) but have NO row in any of Charts 3.1.1-1 through 3.1.1-5 — PUD is expressly a negotiated district and the chart note says a PUD "shall use the requirements in this chart as a baseline for design and development of a PUD ... Deviations from any requirements in Chart 3.1.1-1. may be approved by a PUD", which is the PUD-refusal case, not a table row. FM-1 (Section 3.1.15), STR-1 (Section 3.1.16) and T (Section 3.1.17) are overlays/temporary district, not base districts. M-1 is codified as its own row carrying the chart's shared "R-1/M-1" values, which the ordinance states explicitly (M-1 detached single-family dwellings are "subject to the conditions and limitations and site development regulations for the R-1 single-family residential district set forth in Section 3.1.4"). NOT READ / NOT CROSS-CHECKED: Chart 3.1.1-6 (land use table) was not extracted — it is a use table, not a dimensional table. No second primary source was cross-checked: Jonestown has no staged zoning layer in our corpus (`city:Travis:jonestown-tx` is a zoning-refused no-table row) and no code-section atom corpus exists for this jurisdiction, so every value is primary-source-verified.
